doc.title: Marilyn Crispell interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 21, 2022

title: Thanks and wrap-up
summary: Rowe thanks Crispell and wishes artists well.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well thank you. It’s been very informative and I love to meet the people behind the interesting music. I wish we were doing this face to face.
We almost are. And I wish that, I hope things open up for you as for all artists and they can get back to the work at hand.
